skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of urban management and administrative affairs.
Grasp the structure of urban administration and its functions.
Comprehend the process of making administrative decisions in urban settings.
Recognize and classify legal documents related to urban administration.
Apply techniques for analyzing urban management policies.
Demonstrate effective teamwork skills through group activities.
Show proficiency in gathering information relevant to urban management issues.
Develop awareness of social context and ethical responsibilities in urban administration.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to evaluate urban management policies.
